name: Approvals widget
summary: Retired 2026-10-12: the approvals widget is gone; the waiting on you widget lists approvals and the rest of what the top bell holds.
description: Retired. The widget drew the inbox's own cards in a cell. The owner, 2026-10-12: "remove the obsoleted widget, give it a new name and description." Every saved placement of it (drawer widget area, either session rail, glance tile, Home grid) is rewritten on load into a waiting on you widget copy that lists approvals only (server side for the placements, src/core/widget_placement/retired_widgets.py; the Home grid through the replaced block of src/data/widgets.json). The approval inbox, its pane and its routes are unchanged.
where: Home screen once added: a cell titled approvals with a check mark.
The drawer's widget area at the bottom of the agents tab, once added.
how_to: Open the edit layout control at the bottom of the drawer.
Search widgets for approvals; press the card to put it on the home page, or press the one under drawer area to put it in the drawer.
Press an option on a card to answer it, or jump to open its session.
examples: Leave the widget on the home page and answer a permission prompt from any session without opening the inbox.
See nothing waiting at a glance when no session needs you.
media_exempt: A widget whose screenshots are captured before the next version bump.
